correctness.rationale: The graph is explicitly fixed by the twelve cycle edges and six chords. The least-unmatched-vertex recursion exhausts all 17 perfect matchings, and the downward closure has 761 nonempty faces. The label-toggle matching yields 377 incidence pairs and seven critical cells: one zero-cell and six two-cells. Reconstructed the complete oriented face-poset Hasse graph and verified a topological ordering of all 761 vertices, proving acyclicity rather than trusting a success log. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore gives a CW complex with one point and six attached two-cells, i.e. wedge^6 S² integrally. Independent edge-subset enumeration reproduced the ordinary f-vector and exactly 72 missing three-edge matchings. This is a finite proof certificate; no field-homology-only inference is used.
